scope_guards: The 10,800-home outline permission baseline and 20,000 register maximum are retained as different fields and are not summed.
The current note that the increase application remains pending is preserved; 20,000 is not silently treated as final consent.
The legacy LBBD38 row is provenance and not a second development site.
The 734 built and 414 under-construction figures are a July 2016 snapshot and not current completion totals.
Reserved-matters and variation records are part of the wider development lineage and are not automatically additive.
Local Plan allocation identity is not exact planning red-line or HMLR title topology.
Non-public ownership category is not a named proprietor or title number.
No score or promotion is written without reconciled current consent, exact title relation and executed overlays.
